jobs.description:
Restaurant Manager for Indian Restaurant

Pippali Indian Grill is looking for an experienced Restaurant Manager!

Pippali Indian Grill is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian food with a focus on quality, flavour, hospitality and traditional cooking culture. We are looking for a responsible and experienced Restaurant Manager to help manage the daily operations of the restaurant and ensure a high standard of service, organisation and guest experience.

As our Restaurant Manager, you will be responsible for the daily coordination of the restaurant, including staff planning, customer service, communication between the kitchen and front-of-house, purchasing, quality control and general operational management. You will play an important role in ensuring that the restaurant runs efficiently and professionally every day.

Your main tasks will include:
Managing and coordinating the daily restaurant operations
Planning staff schedules and assigning daily tasks
Supervising and supporting kitchen and service staff
Ensuring a high level of customer service and guest satisfaction
Handling customer enquiries, feedback and complaints professionally
Coordinating communication between kitchen staff and front-of-house staff
Assisting with purchasing, stock control and supplier coordination
Ensuring compliance with hygiene, food safety and workplace procedures
Helping maintain quality, efficiency and consistency in restaurant operations
Supporting management with administrative and operational tasks
Training and guiding new employees when needed

We expect that you:
Have relevant education in hospitality, restaurant management, business or a related field, or equivalent documented professional experience
Have experience from the restaurant, hospitality or food service industry
Have experience with staff coordination, planning and daily operations
Can work independently and take responsibility for running daily restaurant tasks
Have good communication and organisational skills
Are service-minded, reliable, flexible and solution-oriented
Can handle a busy restaurant environment and make decisions under pressure
Have knowledge of hygiene, food safety and restaurant service standards
Can communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not required.
Knowledge of Indian food culture, Indian cuisine or Indian restaurant operations is an advantage.

Documentation of qualifications

Applicants should be able to document their professional background through relevant certificates, diplomas, employment references, recommendation letters, previous employment records or other documentation showing education and/or practical experience in restaurant management, hospitality, business operations or staff coordination.

We offer:
A full-time position in an Indian restaurant
A responsible role with influence on daily operations
A workplace with focus on authentic food, quality and good service
A friendly and professional working environment
The opportunity to use your management experience in the Danish restaurant industry
Salary according to qualifications and agreement
Employment terms according to Danish standards

Please write in the subject field that you are applying for the manager position. We look forward to hearing from you!

North Indian Cook for Indian Restaurant

Pippali Indian Grill is looking for an experienced North Indian Cook

Pippali Indian Grill is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian food with a focus on quality, flavour and traditional cooking methods. We are looking for a skilled and reliable cook with experience in North Indian cuisine to join our kitchen team.

As our new cook, you will be responsible for preparing and cooking Indian dishes, especially North Indian specialities such as curries, tandoori dishes, marinades, sauces, biryani and traditional vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. You will help ensure that our food is prepared consistently, hygienically and to a high standard.

Your main tasks will include:
Preparing and cooking authentic North Indian dishes
Preparing marinades, sauces, curries and spice mixes
Working with tandoor, grill and traditional Indian cooking techniques
Ensuring good food quality, taste and presentation
Maintaining hygiene and food safety standards in the kitchen
Helping with daily kitchen preparation and cleaning
Cooperating with the rest of the kitchen and restaurant team

We expect that you:
Have relevant culinary education or equivalent documented professional experience as a cook
Have experience with North Indian cuisine, preferably from an Indian restaurant kitchen
Have strong knowledge of Indian spices, ingredients, marinades and traditional cooking methods
Can prepare North Indian dishes independently and consistently
Can work with tandoor, grill, curry preparation and other Indian kitchen techniques
Can work independently and handle a busy kitchen environment
Are reliable, flexible and quality-conscious
Can follow hygiene and food safety procedures
Can communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not required.

Documentation of qualifications
Applicants should be able to document their professional background through relevant certificates, employment references, recommendation letters, previous employment records or other documentation showing education and/or practical experience as a cook.

We offer:
A full-time position in an Indian restaurant
A workplace with focus on authentic food and good service
A friendly and professional working environment
The opportunity to use your experience with Indian cuisine in Denmark
Salary according to qualifications and agreement
Employment terms according to Danish standards

jobs.occupation: Senior Lead Project Manager for IT Technology project
jobs.description:
Are you a very experienced Project Manager with a passion for driving big and complex projects involving software development together with a big global vendor? Do you enjoy leading highly skilled teams in a dynamic and international environment? Then you may be our new Senior Lead Project Manager.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Join Nordic RCC and contribute to ensuring a secure and sustainable energy in the future.

Job description

Nordic RCC seeks a skilled and experienced Project Manager to drive an IT project with many internal and external stakeholders, several deliverables and milestones, delivered within agreed go-live dates.

You will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of the project as scoping, planning, execution and delivery. Working closely together with a big global vendor and senior stakeholders across Nordic RCC, you will ensure seamless collaboration and a transparent strong approach to project management.

You will guide the project team incl. project managers through strong project risk management and planning, dependencies to other projects, financial control, stakeholder alignment, and progress monitoring in close collaboration with the internal and external Steercos, ensuring alignment with Nordic RCC’s goals.

Your primary tasks and areas of responsibility:

• 
Facilitate a strong collaboration and communication among program/project stakeholders from the different departments in the organization, the vendor's project organisation and the internal/external Steercos

• 
In control of budget, forecast and monthly financial updates, incl. alignment with financial milestones from vendor

• 
In control of project scope, resource needs according to project plan, manage project risks continuously through the project lifetime in close collaboration with vendor, internal project managers and the Steercos

• 
In control of develop, coordinate, communicate and execute project plans with clear milestones and deadlines, ensuring to deliver all milestones on time in close collaboration with both vendor and Nordic RCC

• 
Monitor program/project progress, assess performance, and report outcomes to key stakeholders/Steercos by monthly meetings and reporting to Leadership team in Nordic RCC

• 
Lead a strong transition from each go-live to operational phase, ensuring an organized handover to line organization for the different deliverables

• 
Use best practices and processes, e.g. Stage Gate Model, Governance model, Resource management, Project Risk Management etc. to provide the optimal guidance to cross-functional project teams throughout the project lifecycle with focus on balancing quality, efficiency, deliver on time and financials

Required skills and experience

The ideal candidate holds a BA or MA in IT with strong project or program management experience working with software development in an IT project in collaboration with a big global vendor.

Key skills include:

• 
Strong drive and passion for project management, ensuring the project teams deliver on time in expected quality/scope and in control of finance

• 
Strong organizational, planning and time management skills

• 
Proven track record in managing senior stakeholder expectations and leading cross-functional teams in collaboration with an IT vendor

• 
Experience in communicating both big-picture objectives and project details, ensuring all project managers/team members understand their roles and contributions

• 
Demonstrated ability to identify challenges early and proactively drive deliverables in collaboration with vendor and project teams

• 
At least 10 years of relevant experience in IT project management with a global vendor

• 
Relevant project management certificates and e.g., relevant change management certificates

• 
Full professional proficiency in English

Employment conditions

You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 24 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

 Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined. 

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) on https://www.globesearch.dk/jobs/8221470 . We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A position as a full-time research assistant is vacant in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to one year with the possibility of extension and/or continuing further as a PhD student, subject to funding and fulfilment of SDU's PhD admission requirements.

Job description

The position primarily consists of research within tissue regeneration, epithelial biology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with limited research-based teaching or supervision activities where relevant. The research assistant will join a translational research programme that aims to understand how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be therapeutically targeted to restore safe and durable mucosal healing.

The position will suit a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in mucosal biology, epithelial regeneration, organoid models, immune-stromal-epithelial interactions, single-cell and spatial technologies, and clinically oriented biomedical research. The successful candidate will work at the interface of experimental biology, translational medicine and omics-based research.

Research environment

The research assistant will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Institute for Molecular Medicine and the Department of Clinical Research at SDU. The project benefits from close interactions among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop practical and analytical skills in experimental and translational biomedicine, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and prepare for a potential subsequent PhD project.

Research project

The project investigates how prior inflammation leaves a lasting memory in the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how this memory affects mucosal healing in IBD. The research assistant will help establish and apply experimental models based on patient-derived intestinal biopsies, organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures to study epithelial regeneration in health and disease.

The work will also support the generation and functional validation of findings from single-cell and spatial approaches, including single-cell RNA sequencing, single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. Depending on experience and project needs, the research assistant may contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering of patient-derived organoids.

Key responsibilities

• 
Establish, maintain and experimentally manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and relevant co-culture systems involving fibroblasts and immune cells.

• 
Design and perform functional assays to assess epithelial regeneration, inflammatory responses, barrier function and cell-state plasticity.

• 
Apply molecular and cellular methods such as qPCR, immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA-based assays and related techniques.

• 
Support sample preparation and experimental workflows for single-cell and spatial transcriptomic or epigenomic studies.

• 
Contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering and functional validation of candidate pathways, depending on prior experience.

• 
Work with patient-derived material in close collaboration with clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers.

• 
Maintain accurate experimental records, analyse and document results, and contribute to protocol development and optimisation.

• 
Present results at group meetings and contribute to scientific reports, manuscripts, conferences, teaching and collaborative activities where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant is expected to hold a relevant master's degree or equivalent qualification in molecular biology, biomedicine, immunology, cell biology, biotechnology, medicine, bioinformatics or a closely related discipline.

Essential qualifications

• 
A strong interest in mucosal biology, tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, inflammatory disease and translational biomedical research.

• 
Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, molecular biology, primary cells, organoids, immunology, epithelial biology, inflammation research or related experimental systems.

• 
Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

• 
A structured, curious and technically careful working style, with the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

• 
Good organisational skills and a commitment to reproducible research, careful documentation and responsible handling of research data and biological material.

Desirable qualifications

• 
Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, immune-cell culture, fibroblast culture or epithelial-stromal-immune co-culture models.

• 
Familiarity with qPCR, immunostaining, confocal or advanced microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA or MSD assays, and CRISPR-based genetic engineering.

• 
Experience with, or a strong interest in learning, single-cell RNA sequencing, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, spatial epigenomics or computational analysis of omics datasets.

• 
Interest in developing and optimising experimental models that connect mechanistic biology with clinically relevant questions in IBD and mucosal healing.

• 
Previous experience with bioinformatics, statistics or image analysis will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

As our Community Lead, you will develop meaningful relationships between ONLY BRAND HOUSE and the people, places and cultural communities surrounding our brand.

Identify emerging communities, people and cultural movements relevant to ONLY

• 
Develop and execute events, gatherings, launches, pop-ups and cultural activations from concept to delivery

Develop creative partnerships with relevant talent, venues, organisations and complementary brands

• 
Collaborate with Social and Communications on talent, seeding and organic brand relationships

Shape and develop ONLY’s international community approach

• 
Build long-term relationships with creatives, tastemakers and cultural connectors

• 
Turn ideas and cultural opportunities into real-world experiences and activations

• 
Work across markets and bring local insights and perspectives into the brand

• 
Join a collaborative Brand team where new ideas and perspectives are encouraged

Have 3–5 years of experience in community, events, experiential marketing, cultural marketing, PR or a related field

jobs.occupation: Rzeźnik - Rozbiór Łopatki Wieprzowej / Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning
jobs.description:
Pracuj w Danii jako rzeźnik – atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie, elastyczność i stabilne warunki pracy. Danish Crown to jedna z największych firm spożywczych w Europie. Oferujemy stabilne warunki zatrudnienia i pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku.

Opis stanowiska

• Wykonywanie rozbioru łopatki wieprzowej zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami jakości i wydajności.

• Precyzyjna praca nożem na linii produkcyjnej, z dbałością o detale.

• Monitorowanie i utrzymywanie wysokiej jakości cięcia oraz efektywności pracy.

• Ścisłe przestrzeganie zasad higieny i bezpieczeństwa pracy na każdym etapie produkcji

Wymagania

• Ugruntowane doświadczenie w rozbiorze mięsa, najlepiej w pracy z łopatką wieprzową lub przodami.

• Doskonała umiejętność sprawnego i precyzyjnego posługiwania się nożem.

• Udokumentowane doświadczenie w pracy na ubojni lub w zakładzie mięsnym.

• Zdolność do efektywnej i samodzielnej pracy w tempie produkcyjnym od pierwszego dnia.

• Sprawność fizyczna oraz odpowiedzialność w wykonywaniu powierzonych zadań.

Oferujemy

• Atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie godzinowe z dodatkami, 176 dkk + 12,20% czyli 197,58 dkk z możliwością wzrostu po przejściu na system akordowy.

• Stabilne zatrudnienie bezpośrednio u duńskiego pracodawcy Danish Crown, z pełnym pakietem socjalnym (urlop, emerytura).

• Wsparcie w procesie relokacji i adaptacji w Danii (CPR, podatki, ubezpieczenie, zakwaterowanie).

• Pomoc w języku polskim oraz innych językach, a także wprowadzenie w życie i pracę w Danii.

English version:

Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning

Work in Denmark as a butcher– attractive salary, flexibility and stable working conditions

For our customer, Danish Crown - one of Europe’s largest food companies - we are looking for experienced pork butchers for shoulder deboning (pork front ends) at abattoirs in Blans, Denmark.

Working in Denmark means clear employment conditions under collective agreements, pension schemes, paid holidays and stable working conditions. At Danish Crown you will join an international workplace with colleagues from many different countries.

The work is guided by clear values. Safety first is the most important principle – employees must always be able to work safely and return home safely every day.

Danish Crown is also focusing strongly on employee well-being and development. Employees should feel comfortable in their work, understand their role in the production and see how their contribution creates value for the company.
The company culture is based on teamwork, responsibility and mutual respect, where colleagues support each other and everyone is treated fairly.

Please note: You will be employed directly by Danish Crown from your first day of work

Job tasks

• Deboning of pork shoulders (front ends)
• Knife work in high-volume pork production
• Ensuring correct cutting and optimal meat yield
• Following hygiene and safety procedures
• Supporting other tasks in the cutting room when required

Candidate requirements

• Experience with deboning
• Preferably experience with pork shoulders / front ends
• Good knife skills
• Experience from a abattoirs or meat processing plant
• Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment
• Physically fit and reliable

Candidates must be able to work independently with deboning from the first working days.

Salary and working conditions

• Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.

• After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework (akkord), where the hourly rate will increase significantly.

• Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance

• Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)

• Canteen facilities

• Opportunities for training and development

We also offer: 

• Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

• Help with accomodation near the working place.

• Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

• Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift
Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.
If flexible benefits and accumulated hours are used for time off, employees can potentially have up to around 10 weeks of time off per year.

Evening shift
32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

Employees on the evening shift do not accumulate extra hours, but instead have a weekly rotating day off, which means that approximately every fifth weekend they can have both Friday and Monday off.

Evening shift employees also receive additional evening pay for many of their working hours.

Application
If you are interested in the job, please complete the application form and attach your CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Ewa Pedersen email ewape@jks.dk telefon: +45.61204070.

We look forward to hearing from you!
